invoice-tracker-pro v1.0.0

- Initial release providing a comprehensive freelance billing workflow.
- Generate professional invoices with custom templates and support for recurring billing.
- Track invoice payment statuses and run aging reports.

- Reconcile client payments and manage late fees automatically.
- Organize billing records for financial reporting and tax documentation.
